title: Shadow Traffic (Shadow Evals) — Beta Release Checklist
body:
Doc purpose
- Working release checklist for Shadow Traffic / “Shadow Evals” beta launch.
- Audience: Release Eng, SRE, Platform, Console, Telemetry, Security.
- Scope: gating tests, rollout order by region, observability prerequisites, rollback steps.
- Hard requirement: shadow must never block or alter primary responses; primary-path p99 must remain within budget.

Release snapshot
- Feature name: Shadow Traffic (Shadow Evals)
- Control plane: RoutePolicy schema w/ shadow targets + sampling + allowlists
- Data plane: shadow runner async execution path
- Telemetry: shadow_eval.* metrics/events + aggregation datasets
- Console: Shadow Evals dashboard + rollout policy quality gates

Owners / escalation
- Release DRI: Connor O’Brien
- Eng DRI (Console/Tooling): Dylan Brooks
- SRE DRI: Sean Gallagher (backup: Rafael Mendes)
- Telemetry DRI: Logan Wright
- Security/Compliance DRI: Naomi Feldman
- Product DRI: Marissa Cole (backup: Paula Mendes)

Definitions
- “Beta” = feature-flagged, allowlisted accounts only, limited regions, with explicit quotas/capacity budgets.
- “Shadow-only failure” = shadow run errors/timeouts/drops; acceptable within limits, must not page on-call for primary SLO unless correlated.

========================
0) Go/No-Go criteria (must all be true)
========================
[ ] Beta accounts confirmed + allowlist in place (Product)
    - Owner: Marissa Cole
    - Notes: keep list in PM-612; do not broaden without go/no-go.

[ ] SLO impact validated: primary p99 unchanged within budget under max beta sampling (SRE)
    - Owner: Sean Gallagher
    - Evidence: perf canary green + load test results recorded (ENG-2440).

[ ] Kill switch verified in prod for each region (SRE/Platform)
    - Owner: Rafael Mendes
    - Must support: global disable + per-route disable; no deploy required.

[ ] Telemetry guardrails enabled (Telemetry)
    - Owner: Logan Wright
    - Includes: tag allowlists, bucketing, drop counters, and backpressure behavior.

[ ] Security approval complete for data retention + redaction defaults (Security)
    - Owner: Naomi Feldman
    - Must include: customer opt-out controls and residency constraints.

[ ] Runbook reviewed by on-call rotation; paging rules tuned (SRE)
    - Owner: Rafael Mendes

[ ] Support/CS briefed with customer-facing FAQ + “how to disable” steps (Product/Support enablement)
    - Owner: Marissa Cole

========================
1) Pre-release engineering gates (code + config)
========================
1.1 Code merged + deployed
[ ] Data plane: shadow runner worker and hooks deployed to all beta regions
    - Owner: Vikram Singh / Emily Zhao
    - Reference: ENG-2419, PR-48231

[ ] Control plane: RoutePolicy schema + validation + migrations deployed
    - Owner: Ethan Park / Benji Okafor
    - Reference: ENG-2420, PR-48244
    - Validate safe defaults: sampling=0%, targets empty, logging disabled unless explicitly enabled.

[ ] Rate limiting + queue backpressure shipped
    - Owner: Cole Summers / Amara Diallo
    - Reference: PR-48275

[ ] Kill switch endpoints + Console admin controls shipped
    - Owner: Jada Williams / Chloe Martin
    - Reference: ENG-2443, PR-48302

[ ] Payload redaction + logging allowlists shipped
    - Owner: Marcus Lin / Kevin Osei
    - Reference: PR-48288

[ ] Rollout policy integration: quality gates can reference shadow metrics
    - Owner: Paula Mendes / Jin Woo Park
    - Reference: PR-48347

1.2 Configuration and safety defaults
[ ] Global feature flag present and default OFF
    - Owner: Dylan Brooks
    - Notes: flag name used in Console + control plane must match.

[ ] Per-route enablement requires explicit allowlist + sampling cap
    - Owner: Jordan Lee
    - Notes: Ensure policy engine rejects configs missing allowlist during beta.

[ ] Quotas/capacity budgets configured per region
    - Owner: Vanessa Ortiz / Keiko Yamamoto
    - Notes: budgets must be enforced via queue + worker concurrency limits.

========================
2) Test gates (must be completed before first region enablement)
========================
2.1 Functional correctness
[ ] Shadow never modifies primary response payload, headers, or streaming behavior
    - Owner: Leila Farouk
    - Tests: regression suite in staging + prod canary route.

[ ] Request_id propagation: primary <-> shadow join works end-to-end
    - Owner: Caleb Johnson
    - Verification: tracing shows linked spans; telemetry join produces matched pairs.

[ ] Failure/timeout semantics: shadow timeouts do not affect primary success
    - Owner: Emily Zhao
    - Verify: induce shadow target failure; primary still 2xx with baseline latency.

2.2 Performance / reliability
[ ] Perf canary (primary latency) green for 24h with shadow enabled at beta max sampling
    - Owner: Sean Gallagher
    - Reference: perf-canary PR-144

[ ] Load test completed per matrix (sampling %, concurrency, regions) with pass/fail recorded
    - Owner: Sean Gallagher / Vanessa Ortiz
    - Reference: ENG-2440, “shadow-runner-load-test-plan-sheet”

[ ] Cardinality test: no unbounded dimensions emitted; ingestion within limits
    - Owner: Thomas Baird
    - Reference: ENG-2435

2.3 Security / privacy
[ ] Redaction verified on representative payloads (PII patterns + customer-specific sensitive fields)
    - Owner: Kevin Osei
    - Must confirm: stored payload samples are either disabled by default or redacted per policy.

[ ] Retention defaults configured (beta)
    - Owner: Naomi Feldman
    - Notes: confirm deletion jobs and access controls; confirm audit trail for restricted access.

========================
3) Observability prerequisites (must exist before first region enablement)
========================
3.1 Dashboards
[ ] SRE overview dashboard live: queue depth, shadow error rate, drop counts, worker CPU/GPU utilization
    - Owner: Allison Grant / Logan Wright
    - Reference: observability-pack PR-287

[ ] Console dashboard MVP live behind beta flag; query endpoints stable
    - Owner: Chloe Martin / Alicia Perez
    - Reference: ENG-2431/ENG-2432, PR-48320/PR-48333

3.2 Alerts (paging vs ticket)
[ ] Paging alert: queue depth sustained above threshold (region-scoped)
    - Owner: Sean Gallagher
    - Notes: tune to avoid load test noise; page only if sustained AND drops increasing.

[ ] Paging alert: kill switch activation detected (audit + page release DRI)
    - Owner: Rafael Mendes

[ ] Ticket alert: shadow error rate elevated but primary healthy
    - Owner: Sean Gallagher
    - Notes: shadow-only failures should not page unless they threaten capacity budget.

[ ] Ticket alert: metric cardinality protection dropping tags/events above threshold
    - Owner: Thomas Baird

3.3 Logging + traces
[ ] Tracing sampling configured so shadow spans are visible without exploding cost
    - Owner: Caleb Johnson

[ ] Log access controls validated (restricted groups only)
    - Owner: Marcus Lin

========================
4) Beta rollout plan (order by region + sequencing)
========================
Guiding principles
- Start with lowest-risk region and smallest allowlisted account set.
- Keep sampling at 0% until observability is verified in-region.
- Increase sampling gradually with explicit sign-off.
- Do not enable judge scoring + payload storage in the same step as turning on mirroring (separate blast radius).

Regions (proposed)
- Phase 0 (staging): continuous
- Phase 1: us-east-1
- Phase 2: us-west-2
- Phase 3: eu-west-1
- Phase 4: ap-southeast-1 (only if capacity budget approved)

Rollout steps per region
Step A — Deploy + verify passive readiness (no shadow execution)
[ ] Confirm binaries/config deployed
[ ] Confirm dashboards show “0 shadow events” baseline (ensures queries work)
[ ] Confirm kill switch toggles correctly
    - Owner: SRE on duty + Release DRI

Step B — Enable feature for allowlisted routes with sampling=0%
[ ] Apply RoutePolicy updates for allowlisted accounts/routes
[ ] Validate config acceptance + no unexpected traffic to shadow queue
    - Owner: Policy DRI (Jordan Lee) + Release DRI

Step C — Turn on mirroring at 0.1% sampling (cap tokens + concurrency)
[ ] Confirm queue depth stable; drop counts near zero
[ ] Confirm no primary p95/p99 regression
    - Owner: SRE DRI

Step D — Increase sampling to beta target (per account) in 2–3 increments
- 0.1% -> 0.5% -> 1.0% (default cap; higher requires SRE + Product sign-off)
[ ] After each increment: 30–60 min observation window + perf canary check
    - Owner: Release DRI coordinates; SRE signs off

Step E — Enable judge scoring (if configured) + validate metrics
[ ] Confirm judge job throughput and cost within budget
[ ] Confirm quality metrics populate (win-rate, format adherence, safety outcomes)
    - Owner: Jonas Weber / Selene Huang

Step F — Expand to next region
[ ] Region go/no-go recorded in #eng-releases
    - Owner: Release DRI

Beta account rollout sequencing (within a region)
- 1) Internal Redwood dogfood routes (if applicable)
- 2) One design partner account (lowest traffic)
- 3) Remaining beta accounts

========================
5) Communication checklist
========================
[ ] Announce start of beta rollout in #eng-releases + #eng-sre + #product with region + time window
    - Owner: Connor O’Brien

[ ] Create/Update internal status note with current sampling caps + allowlisted accounts
    - Owner: Talia Benson

[ ] Notify Support/CS of enablement steps and expected customer-visible behavior (“no impact”)
    - Owner: Marissa Cole

[ ] If incident occurs: comms template ready (what happened, mitigation, customer impact statement)
    - Owner: Rafael Mendes

========================
6) Rollback / disable procedure (fast path)
========================
Principle: safest immediate mitigation is to stop shadow execution (sampling->0 or kill switch). Do not touch primary routing unless explicitly required.

6.1 Immediate kill (global)
Trigger examples
- Primary latency regression correlated with shadow enablement
- GPU saturation causing broader fleet impact
- Unbounded queue growth / worker thrash

Steps
1) Toggle GLOBAL shadow kill switch to OFF (no deploy)
   - Owner: SRE on duty
2) Verify within 2–5 minutes:
   - shadow queue depth drains or stabilizes
   - shadow drop counts stop increasing
   - primary p99 returns to baseline
3) Post in #incidents and #eng-releases:
   - “Shadow Traffic globally disabled; investigating; no primary behavior changes expected aside from resource recovery.”

6.2 Scoped disable (per-route / per-account)
1) Set sampling=0% for the affected route/account
2) Disable judge scoring first if the issue is cost/latency in judge pipeline
3) If necessary, remove shadow targets from policy

6.3 Rollback deploy (only if needed)
- If kill switch does not stabilize:
  1) Disable shadow worker autoscaling / set replicas to 0 for affected region
  2) Roll back last shadow-related deploy per standard change management
  3) Open incident if primary SLO risk persists

Verification queries (operator checklist)
[ ] shadow_eval.requests_total drops to ~0 after kill switch
[ ] shadow runner queue depth returns to baseline
[ ] primary latency dashboards show no persistent regression
[ ] No elevated 5xx on primary routes

========================
7) Post-rollout validation (24–72h after enabling first region)
========================
[ ] Confirm metrics completeness: join-rate between primary/shadow above threshold
    - Owner: Mei Lin / Logan Wright

[ ] Confirm cost attribution: shadow token usage visible and bounded
    - Owner: Nadia Rahman

[ ] Confirm no recurring noisy pages; adjust alert thresholds if needed
    - Owner: Sean Gallagher

[ ] Capture beta learnings + update checklist for GA
    - Owner: Connor O’Brien / Talia Benson

========================
Appendix: Known sharp edges / reminders
========================
- Do not add new metric dimensions during beta without telemetry review (cardinality risk).
- Keep sampling caps conservative until perf canary shows stability in each region.
- Separate “enable mirroring” from “enable payload storage/judge scoring” to reduce blast radius.
- Any customer request to retain raw prompts/outputs must go through Security/Compliance review (data classification + retention).

Change log
- 2025-11-04: Added explicit Step E (judge scoring enablement) separation.
- 2025-11-10: Updated alert guidance: shadow-only failures -> tickets by default.
- 2025-11-18: Added verification query checklist and region sequencing tweaks (EU before APAC if capacity constrained).
